methodology: Use only the current official 2026-2027 college catalog, official catalog-owned option dictionaries, and official graduation-policy pages.
Treat term headings as organization for the published requirement inventory, not as prospective or recommended schedules; retain the requirements and discard term order.
Follow every category or pseudo-course link needed to enumerate a closed course menu. Preserve a source-owned category only when the official source genuinely does not publish a closed list.

Preserve AND sequences, OR choices, credit ranges, category-distinctness, prerequisite substitutions, and cross-slot no-double-count rules. Retain source arithmetic conflicts instead of silently repairing them.

degree.catalog_program_title: Associate of Science (AS) in Computer Science

general_education: one UCGS Block II Art or Humanities course; Literature is excluded
two distinct UCGS Block IV natural-science courses

degree.arithmetic: The non-math requirements total 47. The canonical distinct math route MTH 161 + MTH 162 + MTH 263 + MTH 266 contributes 13, closing at 60. Distinct math routes top out at 15, or 62 overall. The printed 63 maximum independently selects MTH 263 and MTH 264 twice and therefore cannot represent 63 distinct earned credits.

other_rules: Complete all course and credit-hour requirements.
Receive certification from the appropriate college official.
File the graduation application and resolve college obligations.

sources.evidence: Current award identity, every fixed row, Computer Science 1 and 2 menus, prerequisite substitution, and published 60/63 total.
Current closed Block II, III, and VI UCGS menus and the different-category rule for the two Block II choices.
Current 25-percent institutional-credit minimum and 2.0 curriculum GPA.
Current course identities, titles, credit values, and course-applicability policy.

choice_slots: one of BIO 101, CHM 111, GOL 105, or PHY 241
one Computer Science 1 course from the sixteen-course menu
7-10 Computer Science 2 credits from the seventeen-course menu
general_education: two three-credit UCGS Block II courses from different categories
requirement_logic.prerequisite_credit_rule: When MTH 161 and MTH 162 are required before MTH 263, they may fulfill Computer Science elective requirements.

degree.arithmetic: The all-minimum route has 50 credits before Computer Science 2 and therefore allocates ten approved Computer Science 2 credits to close at 60. Three independent one-credit option increases produce the published 63 maximum; the Computer Science 2 source range allows its allocation to fall as other applicable credits rise.
